notes.title: The Last Major Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Major update version 0.16.1[/h1]
This won't be the last update, but it is the last Major update..At least as far as we can tell..

[h3]A.P.A[/h3]
APA is up and running and ready to help the full story is now in the game, this is subject to changes and improvments but for the most part its final.

[h3]Campaign[/h3]
There are now 30 levels in the campaign, the achievement for completing the game without crashing now only requires 30 levels as well.

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
I have had to reset leaderboards from level 8 onwards as all the levels moving forwards from there have been changed. This also means a one time reset for your best times. Sorry!

[h3]Art -  More changes to come![/h3]
All the art has had a major overhaul, with more changes to come as I improve it over time.

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Amount of levels[/h1]
[h3]The Problem[/h3]
[list]
[*] 90 levels is too much for the story.
[*] The space between scenery changes is far too great.
[*] Players get bored before making any substantial progress.
[/list]
[h3]The Solution[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make campaign 30 levels instead of 90, split the other levels out and have them as bonus levels. 
[*] This allows for more engagement with the story
[*] Helps reduce the scope of the game to a more managable level
[/list]
[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
[h3]The Problem[/h3]
[list]
[*] The hover is difficult to work with.
[*] Leaderboard types cant be changed easily by the user.
[*] Limited space for entries
[/list]
[h3]The Solution[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebuild the level select screen.
[*] Make a dedicated section for leaderboards
[*] (Possibly) allow swapping between 'friends' 'top 10' and 'around you' modes.
[/list]

[h1]Timeframe[/h1]
[h3]Time managment: Time working on game vs. Time learning more[/h3]

The issue right now is I've dedicated all of my time to RM which means I'm not spending anytime learning basic things from the course I've been doing, a lot of which I would have been able to use in the creation of RM and saved me a lot of time. 

I am going to spend 2 days a week educating myself, and 3 days working on RM. This will allow me to maintain the current progress rate and maybe even develop faster in the long run. However it does mean for about a week, 2 at most, I won't be releasing any updates.

Your feedback and ideas are immensely helpful to me, so if you want to provide it you can reach me on [url=https://discord.gg/sAfCtNCmPF]discord[/url], I am MrVastayan

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
[h1]New Dialogue![/h1]
[h3]APA[/h3]
APA is BlindsidedGames Automated Personal Assistant, they'll guide you every step of the way, unless you turn them off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42196306/121a5e6e676438afa37e26b91187a6bcde7d5b11.png[/img]

[h1]Game Modes![/h1]
[h3]Speedrun[/h3]
Here at BlindsidedGames we've been hard at work on a speedrunning mode for some time now and we're excited to present them in this update. Please do be aware this is a first look and the system is subject to change. 
[h3]Crashless[/h3]
In this mode you will attempt to get as far as you can in the game without crashing.
This mode replaces the "Reset Crashes" button that used to be in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42196306/45ee8d95f888457f41c4b13fe168e87c87188ab3.png[/img]

Heres a taste of the new UI

[h1]New Levels[/h1]
[h3]Moon[/h3]
10 Moon levels have been added, enjoy a new sense of gravity, and even greater challenges than before!

All game levels are WIP
